name: Wariate Shifts
description: Wariate Shifts — a landing-page theme for shop rota software. White ground, grape-mouse folder tabs with numbered steps, four shop photographs edge to edge under one shallow arch, slash-flanked captions over one pill call to action, reason cards with hanging numerals, a sixty-minute time bar and a drifting row of shop kinds. Inter Tight and Albert Sans. Demo: Wariate Shifts is rota software for independent shops with 1 to 6 locations and 5 to 60 staff. Lay out the week, collect availability, swap shifts, cover a sick day, and export hours for payroll. Book a free 60-minute demo; the first month on any plan is free, and nothing is charged automatically.
